title: Ayushmann and Sharvari to Join Falguni Pathak for Navratri Garba in Mumbai
excerpt: The Yeh Prem Mol Liya stars will take the film's garba track 'Jai Ambe Bol' to a live Mumbai Navratri celebration, according to Bollywood Hungama, ahead of the film's November 27 release.
body:
• Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari are set to join Falguni Pathak at a garba festival in Mumbai to promote Yeh Prem Mol Liya, according to Bollywood Hungama.
  • The appearance centres on 'Jai Ambe Bol', Himesh Reshammiya's first garba composition, sung with Shreya Ghoshal, which crossed 20 million YouTube views in two days, ANI reported.
  • The Sooraj Barjatya family entertainer, produced by Rajshri Productions with Mahaveer Jain Films, releases in theatres on November 27, 2026.
  • Bollywood Hungama gave no specific date or venue for the actors' appearance; readers should check the film's official channels for the confirmed night.

Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari are set to join singer Falguni Pathak at a garba festival in Mumbai as part of the promotion for their upcoming film Yeh Prem Mol Liya, according to Bollywood Hungama. The actors will bring the film's festive track 'Jai Ambe' to the Navratri celebrations and are expected to interact with fans and participate in the celebrations.

Pathak is known for her popular garba performances during Navratri in Mumbai, and the report said the association takes the film's music into a setting closely associated with the festival. Bollywood Hungama did not specify a date or venue for the appearance in the report, so the exact night remains to be confirmed by the makers.

The garba track behind the appearance

The promotional outing follows the release of 'Jai Ambe Bol', a garba song from the Sooraj Barjatya-directed family entertainer. The track is composed by Himesh Reshammiya and marks his first garba song, according to the film's makers.

https://x.com/Bollyhungama/status/2111423540381794580

Pinkvilla reported the song, released on September 29, transports the lead pair into a colourful festive setting with energetic garba sequences, with Shreya Ghoshal lending her voice. ANI, via LatestLY, reported the track crossed 20 million YouTube views in two days, with lyrics by Mayur Puri and choreography by Shabina Khan.

A return for Barjatya's 'Prem'

Yeh Prem Mol Liya stars Ayushmann Khurrana as Prem, a character Pinkvilla described as gentle, simple and innocently mischievous, with the iconic 'Prem' name from Barjatya's films returning after 11 years. It is the first time Ayushmann and Sharvari share screen space.

The film is backed by Rajshri Productions, in association with Mahaveer Jain Films, and is directed by Sooraj Barjatya. All three reports agree it is scheduled to release in theatres on November 27, 2026.

Why a live garba, not just a video launch

Navratri celebrations and garba events draw large crowds across Mumbai each year, making them a prominent platform for music and entertainment, Bollywood Hungama noted. Taking a garba number to a live garba led by Pathak, whose name is closely linked to Mumbai's Navratri season, gives the song an audience already dancing to that format, rather than only streaming it.

For diaspora readers, the moment is familiar territory: a Barjatya family film, a devotional garba track timed for Navratri, and a live festival appearance that mirrors how Navratri is celebrated in community halls and grounds from Mumbai to New Jersey and Toronto. Readers planning to follow the appearance should watch Rajshri's and the actors' official channels for the confirmed date and venue, since the exclusive report did not publish them.

What happens next

The film's music campaign has already moved beyond its title track, released September 20, to the garba number and further songs. With the theatrical release set for November 27, 2026, the Navratri appearance is one stop in a music-led promotional run built around family celebration themes that have defined Barjatya's films.
